dispositions.resolution_action: allocate one new GR theorem family; preserve a hard negative against the Birkhoff ergodic-theorem records
dispositions.rationale: The Schwarzschild metric entry is related but is not the local uniqueness theorem, and the two physics Birkhoff records are ergodic theorems.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the ordinary-Lie-symmetry no-go theorem independently of supersymmetry and Coleman's two-dimensional theorem
dispositions.rationale: The catalog has supersymmetry objects and another Coleman theorem but no Coleman-Mandula claim.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a lattice-gauge theorem with compact-group and no-gauge-fixing hypotheses
dispositions.rationale: Gauge invariance, gauge fixing and lattice gauge theory are principle, method and framework records rather than aliases of Elitzur's theorem.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the relativistic global-symmetry theorem and relate, but do not merge, the two-dimensional Coleman limitation
dispositions.rationale: The source has Goldstone-boson mentions and the Coleman obstruction but not the positive theorem under its exact hypotheses.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a scalar Wightman-field no-go theorem
dispositions.rationale: Interaction-picture and LSZ entries are affected frameworks/results, not Haag's theorem.

dispositions.resolution_action: reuse ATF-00002258 and allocate an exact theorem child; retain THM-P-0720 as the historical umbrella alias
dispositions.rationale: THM-P-0720 already states area nondecrease, while the candidate inventory incorrectly pointed at THM-P-0721, which is black-hole entropy.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the noncontextual-valuation impossibility theorem
dispositions.rationale: Bell, CHSH and GHZ records are distinct locality/nonlocality claims and are not aliases.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the antiunitary-symmetry degeneracy theorem
dispositions.rationale: Generic degenerate perturbation theory and a time-reversal definition do not state the theorem; other Kramers names are lexical collisions.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the locality-bound theorem with interaction-decay and geometry hypotheses
dispositions.rationale: Area-law and entanglement-entropy entries are downstream topics, not the finite-speed commutator bound.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a normal-Fermi-liquid Fermi-volume theorem
dispositions.rationale: Luttinger liquid and the Tomonaga-Luttinger model are distinct phase/model entities and must not absorb this theorem.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the lattice-fermion doubling no-go theorem
dispositions.rationale: Weyl-semimetal, Dirac-equation and lattice-gauge framework records are related but not theorem aliases.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the mixed-state broadcasting characterization
dispositions.rationale: No-cloning and no-deleting are distinct no-go claims; broadcasting only fixes output marginals.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the corrected OS-II Euclidean reconstruction theorem
dispositions.rationale: Lattice regularization and lattice gauge theory are frameworks; reflection positivity alone is not the full reconstruction hypothesis set.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate an assumption-bound psi-ontology no-go theorem
dispositions.rationale: The statistical interpretation and Born-rule records do not include preparation independence or the ontic-overlap conclusion.

dispositions.resolution_action: reuse ATF-00002537 and allocate a uniformly-gapped finite-dimensional exact child
dispositions.rationale: THM-P-1034 is a lexical false negative whose source prose already states the quantum adiabatic core; it must not receive a parallel family.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the local-vacuum cyclicity theorem
dispositions.rationale: LSZ and CPT are distinct QFT theorems and cannot serve as aliases.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a bounded/discrete Wigner-Araki-Yanase measurement limitation
dispositions.rationale: Information-disturbance, measurement-postulate and measurement-framework entries are related but do not state the conservation-law theorem.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the SU(2) irreducible-tensor factorization theorem
dispositions.rationale: The hydrogen selection-rule entry is a consequence/special case, not the representation theorem itself.

dispositions.resolution_action: reuse the Hubble-constant family and add a release-bound empirical discrepancy claim
dispositions.rationale: The catalog has the law and a generic H0 value but lacks the estimator-, dataset- and model-specific discrepancy.

dispositions.resolution_action: add a 2025 experimental-average versus WP25 Standard-Model comparison claim
dispositions.rationale: The status changed materially: the WP25 consolidated prediction is statistically compatible with the final E989-dominated world average, so an old anomaly slogan would be stale.

dispositions.resolution_action: reuse the neutrino-mass-splitting family and add the exact normal-ordering hypothesis with dated open status
dispositions.rationale: Measured absolute mass bounds and mass-squared magnitudes do not decide the sign/order proposition.

dispositions.resolution_action: add a historical-to-current empirical status claim rather than freezing the 2010 anomaly as eternally open
dispositions.rationale: The original muonic-hydrogen discrepancy motivated a puzzle, while later spectroscopy and CODATA 2022 substantially shifted the combined status; extraction-specific residuals remain distinct.

dispositions.resolution_action: catalog the versioned GWTC-5.0 data release as an entity and its selection-content assertion as a separate truth-apt child
dispositions.rationale: A collaboration catalog/data product is not a theorem and must retain release, thresholds, posterior version and data lineage.

dispositions.resolution_action: split three experiment events from three release-specific empirical-result claims; relate them to, but do not merge them with, Bell/CHSH theorem records
dispositions.rationale: A theorem, an experiment event and the statistical conclusion drawn from one frozen dataset are different identities.

dispositions.resolution_action: split M87 and Sagittarius A* calibrated data products from their respective image-domain empirical claims
dispositions.rationale: The generic event-horizon entity is neither either dataset nor either release-specific observation.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a positive-metric scalar two-point spectral-representation theorem
dispositions.rationale: LSZ is downstream and the generic spectral theorem is a different operator-theory claim.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the ray-space transition-probability symmetry theorem
dispositions.rationale: Wigner crystal, Wigner-Dyson, Wigner function, Wigner-Eckart and WAY are hard lexical collisions.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the dimensional-invariant representation theorem
dispositions.rationale: Mach, Prandtl and Reynolds numbers are examples of dimensionless groups rather than the theorem.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a narrow analytic nondegenerate stationary rotating rigidity theorem; relate it to the vague no-hair umbrella without inheriting status
dispositions.rationale: Axisymmetry/rigidity under frozen hypotheses is not identical to full Kerr-Newman uniqueness or the no-hair slogan.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the causal-curve homotopy theorem with the corrected hypotheses
dispositions.rationale: Weak/strong cosmic censorship concern singularities and determinism, not causal visibility of nontrivial topology.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate the center-of-mass cyclotron-resonance theorem
dispositions.rationale: Hohenberg-Kohn, Kohn-Sham and the set-theory Cohen theorem are hard homonyms or distinct results.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a zero-temperature localized-scatterer phase-shift sum rule
dispositions.rationale: Friedel oscillation/name mentions do not provide the excess-charge identity, and interacting variants require separate hypotheses.

dispositions.resolution_action: allocate a three-dimensional short-range central-potential scattering theorem
dispositions.rationale: The half-bound-state correction and phase convention require an exact variant; Borg-Levinson inverse problems are a separate family.

dispositions.resolution_action: catalog the mechanism as a framework entity and its linear-quench freeze-out scaling as a separate model-consequence claim
dispositions.rationale: Kibble-Zurek is not one universal unconditional theorem; the scaling law depends on critical exponents, quench protocol and defect-counting assumptions.

additions.preferred_label: Jebsen-Birkhoff theorem in four-dimensional vacuum general relativity
aliases: 广义相对论中的比尔科夫定理

statement.natural_language: Every C2 four-dimensional spherically symmetric Lorentzian solution of the vacuum Einstein equations with zero cosmological constant is locally a Schwarzschild solution and admits the corresponding additional hypersurface-orthogonal Killing symmetry.
hypotheses: four-dimensional C2 Lorentzian spacetime
spherical symmetry
vacuum Einstein equation R_ab = 0
cosmological constant Lambda = 0
statement.conclusion: Every point has a neighborhood isometric to a member of the Schwarzschild family; the additional Killing field is timelike only in a static exterior region, so no global-staticity claim across horizons is made.
statement.scope: Local 4D vacuum-GR variant. Schwarzschild-(A)dS, matter-coupled and modified-gravity variants are excluded and require separate claims.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem source under the frozen local vacuum hypotheses.

statement.natural_language: For a nontrivial analytic relativistic S-matrix in 3+1 dimensions satisfying the Coleman-Mandula assumptions, every connected ordinary bosonic Lie symmetry of the S-matrix is locally a direct product of the Poincare group and an internal symmetry group.
hypotheses: 3+1-dimensional Poincare-invariant positive-energy scattering theory
finitely many one-particle species below every finite mass
nontrivial scattering at almost all energies
the paper's analyticity and regularity assumptions
ordinary, ungraded Lie symmetry
statement.conclusion: The connected symmetry group has no nontrivial mixing of spacetime and internal generators beyond a local direct product.
statement.scope: Does not cover graded Lie superalgebras; supersymmetry is a loophole/extension, not a counterexample. The theorem is not asserted for theories lacking the required S-matrix or particle-spectrum assumptions.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary proof under the explicitly frozen S-matrix assumptions.

additions.preferred_label: Elitzur's theorem for lattice gauge theories

statement.natural_language: In a lattice gauge theory with compact local gauge group, gauge-invariant local action and measure, and neither gauge fixing nor an explicit symmetry-breaking source, every local observable whose Haar average under a gauge transformation at one site vanishes has zero expectation value.
hypotheses: lattice statistical gauge model
compact local gauge group
gauge-invariant local action and measure
no gauge fixing
no explicit gauge-symmetry-breaking source
local observable with zero one-site Haar average
statement.conclusion: The observable's expectation is zero, so local gauge symmetry cannot spontaneously break through a local gauge-noninvariant order parameter in this scope.
statement.scope: Original lattice/compact-group form. Gauge-fixed remnant symmetries, global symmetries and unrestricted continuum formulations are excluded.

material_status.basis: Primary lattice-gauge proof with exact applicability conditions.

additions.preferred_label: Goldstone theorem for spontaneously broken continuous global symmetry

statement.natural_language: In a local relativistic quantum field theory with an exact continuous global internal symmetry, conserved current, Poincare-invariant vacuum and the usual locality and spectrum assumptions, a nonzero vacuum expectation of the commutator of the charge with a local field forces zero-mass support in the current-field spectral function.
hypotheses: local relativistic QFT
exact continuous global internal symmetry
conserved current j_a^mu
Poincare-invariant vacuum and spectrum condition
some local field Phi with <0|[Q_a,Phi(0)]|0> nonzero
statement.conclusion: A massless excitation couples to the broken current.
statement.scope: Relativistic global-symmetry form. Local gauge symmetry, explicit breaking and general nonrelativistic counting are excluded; Coleman's 1+1-dimensional obstruction is a scope-limiting related theorem.

material_status.basis: Original result and peer-reviewed theorem proof.

additions.preferred_label: Haag's theorem in scalar Wightman-field form

statement.natural_language: If a free scalar Wightman field and another scalar field satisfying the corresponding covariance, spectrum, unique-vacuum and irreducibility assumptions are related by a time-independent unitary that implements the required equal-time interaction-picture equivalence, then the second field has the free two-point function and is itself free.
hypotheses: scalar Wightman fields
Poincare covariance and spectrum condition
unique vacuum and irreducibility assumptions
time-independent unitary intertwining the required equal-time field and conjugate/time-derivative data
statement.conclusion: A genuinely interacting Wightman field cannot be exactly unitarily equivalent to the free Fock field through the naive interaction picture.
statement.scope: Scalar Wightman version. Gauge, cutoff, finite-volume, algebraic and other variants require separate scopes; the theorem does not invalidate perturbative renormalized calculations.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem source plus independent analysis of the assumptions and conclusion.

additions.preferred_label: Hawking area theorem for classical future event horizons

statement.natural_language: For a sufficiently regular classical future event horizon satisfying the required predictability or future-completeness hypotheses and the null convergence condition, the area of later compact spacelike horizon cross-sections is not smaller than the area of earlier ones.
hypotheses: classical future event horizon with the required regularity
future completeness or the applicable predictability condition for generators
null convergence R_ab k^a k^b >= 0 for every null k
ordered compact spacelike cross-sections S1 preceding S2
statement.conclusion: Area(S2) >= Area(S1).
statement.scope: Classical event horizons in the theorem's causal/regularity regime. Semiclassical Hawking evaporation and the generalized second law are excluded.

material_status.basis: Hawking's theorem and a later regularity analysis under the frozen hypotheses.

statement.natural_language: On a real or complex Hilbert space of dimension at least three, no noncontextual deterministic 0/1 valuation of every rank-one projector can assign exactly one value 1 to each complete orthonormal-basis projector family.
hypotheses: real or complex Hilbert space H with dim(H) >= 3
valuation v on all rank-one projectors with values in {0,1}
the value of a projector is independent of the measurement context
for every orthonormal basis projector family (P_i), sum_i v(P_i) = 1
statement.conclusion: No such valuation exists.
statement.scope: Projective-measurement contextuality theorem. Bell locality, CHSH and GHZ claims are separate.

material_status.basis: Primary finite-configuration impossibility proof.

statement.natural_language: If a self-adjoint Hamiltonian commutes with a domain-preserving antiunitary time-reversal operator whose square is minus the identity, each eigenvector has an orthogonal partner at the same eigenvalue and every finite-multiplicity eigenvalue has even multiplicity.
hypotheses: self-adjoint H on a complex Hilbert space
antiunitary Theta preserves the domain of H
H Theta = Theta H
Theta squared = -I
statement.conclusion: For every eigenvector psi, Theta psi is an orthogonal eigenvector with the same eigenvalue; finite eigenspace dimensions are even.
statement.scope: Time-reversal-odd-square theorem; it is not a statement about generic degeneracy or all time-reversal symmetries.

material_status.basis: Original result and independent theorem exposition.

statement.natural_language: For a quantum spin system on a metric graph with finite-dimensional local spaces and a sufficiently rapidly decaying interaction, commutators of initially separated local observables are exponentially small outside an effective linear light cone.
hypotheses: metric graph or lattice
finite-dimensional on-site Hilbert spaces
finite-range or finite exponential/F-norm interaction
finite disjoint supports X and Y
local observables A in A_X and B in A_Y
statement.conclusion: There are interaction- and geometry-dependent C, mu, v > 0 such that ||[tau_t(A),B]|| <= C ||A|| ||B|| s(X,Y) exp(-mu(d(X,Y)-v|t|)), with the support factor convention fixed by the selected variant.
statement.scope: Many-body locality bound. It gives an effective rather than strictly zero propagation cone, and constants are not universal.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary theorem.

statement.natural_language: At zero temperature in a translationally invariant particle-number-conserving normal Fermi liquid without translation breaking or topological order, the total oriented Fermi-sea volume, with all spin/flavor degeneracies counted, equals the filling modulo filled bands.
hypotheses: translation invariance and unbroken lattice translations
U(1) particle-number conservation
normal Fermi-liquid or adiabatically connected nonfractionalized phase
fixed primitive-cell and spin/flavor conventions
statement.conclusion: sum_a V_F,a/(2 pi)^d is congruent to the particles per primitive cell nu modulo integers; in the continuum without filled-band ambiguity the relation is an equality.
statement.scope: Ordinary Fermi-liquid scope. Fractionalized/topologically ordered phases and the one-dimensional Luttinger-liquid entity are excluded.

material_status.basis: Original many-body proof and independent topological formulation used to bound the scope.

statement.natural_language: For a Hermitian, translation-invariant and local lattice-fermion/Bloch Hamiltonian satisfying the theorem's regularity and exact chiral assumptions on the compact Brillouin torus, the total chirality of isolated Weyl zeros is zero.
hypotheses: Hermitian lattice fermion operator
translation invariance
finite-range or sufficiently local couplings
regular isolated nodes on a compact Brillouin torus
the exact chiral setup of the theorem
statement.conclusion: Weyl-node Chern charges sum to zero; a single unpaired chiral/Weyl fermion cannot occur while all hypotheses are retained.
statement.scope: Lattice no-go theorem. Wilson, staggered and Ginsparg-Wilson constructions alter hypotheses and are not counterexamples.

material_status.basis: The two primary topological proofs.

statement.natural_language: A finite-dimensional family of density operators can be broadcast by one quantum channel exactly when all members of the family commute.
hypotheses: finite-dimensional Hilbert space
density-operator family S
one CPTP map B
for every rho in S both output marginals equal rho
statement.conclusion: Such a common broadcasting channel exists if and only if the density operators in S commute pairwise; therefore no channel broadcasts all quantum states.
statement.scope: Broadcasting constrains both marginals but does not require output rho tensor rho; no-cloning is a distinct special pure-state claim.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary characterization theorem.

aliases: 奥斯特瓦尔德-施拉德重构定理

statement.natural_language: A scalar/bosonic family of Euclidean n-point tempered distributions satisfying the corrected Osterwalder-Schrader regularity/growth, Euclidean covariance, permutation symmetry and reflection-positivity axioms reconstructs a positive-energy Wightman quantum field theory whose Euclidean continuation gives the supplied distributions.
hypotheses: Euclidean n-point tempered distributions
corrected OS-II regularity and growth axiom
Euclidean covariance
permutation symmetry
time-reflection positivity
clustering when uniqueness of the vacuum is claimed
statement.conclusion: There exist a positive Hilbert space, vacuum, positive-energy Poincare representation and fields satisfying the corresponding Wightman axioms, with the given Schwinger functions as Euclidean analytic continuations.
statement.scope: Corrected scalar/bosonic OS-II scope. Reflection positivity alone is insufficient, and fermionic/gauge variants need separate axioms.

material_status.basis: OS-II extends and corrects the earlier sufficiency conditions, so both historical and corrected sources are pinned.

aliases: 普西-巴雷特-鲁道夫定理

statement.natural_language: An ontological model that reproduces the relevant Born probabilities and satisfies preparation independence assigns mutually singular ontic distributions to every pair of distinct pure quantum states.
hypotheses: each pure state psi is represented by a probability measure mu_psi on an ontic space
independently prepared systems have product ontic measures
measurement responses depend on the joint ontic state and setting
the model reproduces Born probabilities for the PBR measurements
statement.conclusion: Distinct pure-state measures have zero ontic overlap; no psi-epistemic model satisfying these assumptions reproduces all targeted quantum statistics.
statement.scope: Preparation-independent ontological-model no-go result. It is not an assumption-free declaration that the wavefunction is objectively real.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed primary no-go proof with preparation independence retained explicitly.

additions.preferred_label: Quantum adiabatic theorem for a uniformly gapped finite-dimensional spectral band

statement.natural_language: For a C2 finite-dimensional Hamiltonian path with a nonempty spectral band separated uniformly from the rest of the spectrum, evolution over total run time T transports the initial band projection to the instantaneous band projection with operator-norm error O(1/T).
hypotheses: H:[0,1] to Herm(d) is C2
spectral projection P(s) is nonempty
a uniform gap g > 0 separates its band from the rest of the spectrum
U_T solves i partial_s U_T = T H(s) U_T with U_T(0)=I
statement.conclusion: uniformly in s, ||U_T(s)P(0)U_T(s)^* - P(s)|| = O(T^-1), so leakage probability from the transported band is O(T^-2).
statement.scope: Finite-dimensional uniformly gapped quantitative variant. Gapless, unbounded and infinite-volume variants are not covered.

material_status.basis: Kato's theorem plus an explicit quantitative bound for the selected smooth gapped variant.

statement.natural_language: In the vacuum sector of a Minkowski Wightman quantum field theory, applying fields smeared inside any nonempty open spacetime region to the vacuum generates a dense subspace.
hypotheses: Minkowski Wightman QFT
vacuum vector Omega in its vacuum sector
nonempty open spacetime region O
test functions supported in O
statement.conclusion: The linear span of local field polynomials applied to Omega is dense; equivalently Omega is cyclic for A(O). With locality and nonempty causal complement, separating is a corollary.
statement.scope: Vacuum-sector Wightman/local-algebra cyclicity. Operational state preparation and superluminal signaling claims do not follow.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem and an independent modern QFT review.

statement.natural_language: For an exact measurement of a discrete-spectrum system observable under an additive conservation law, repeatability or the Yanase pointer condition forces the measured observable to commute with the conserved system part.
hypotheses: discrete-spectrum system observable M
bounded self-adjoint conserved quantities L_S and L_A
measurement interaction U commutes with L_S tensor I + I tensor L_A
the measurement is exact
the measurement is repeatable or its pointer Z satisfies [Z,L_A]=0
statement.conclusion: [M,L_S]=0; if [M,L_S] is nonzero no measurement can simultaneously retain exactness, the conservation law and the selected repeatability/Yanase condition.
statement.scope: Bounded/discrete theorem. Approximate bounds and continuous/unbounded-observable variants are separate.

material_status.basis: Primary theorem and a source clarifying the bounded/unbounded scope.

aliases: 不可约张量矩阵元分解定理

statement.natural_language: For an irreducible SU(2) spherical tensor operator, every angular-momentum-basis matrix element factors into a Clebsch-Gordan coefficient and a reduced matrix element independent of magnetic quantum numbers.
hypotheses: SU(2) angular-momentum irreducible spaces with multiplicity labels alpha
irreducible spherical tensor components T^(k)_q
one fixed Clebsch-Gordan and normalization convention
statement.conclusion: <alpha' j' m'|T^(k)_q|alpha j m> = C^(j'm')_(jm,kq) R^(k)_(alpha'j',alpha j), where R is independent of m,m',q; nonzero coefficients obey m'=m+q and |j-k|<=j'<=j+k.
statement.scope: SU(2) form with multiplicities and convention fixed. General compact-group variants require their own multiplicity/intertwiner statements.

material_status.basis: Peer-reviewed representation-theoretic source.

statement.natural_language: The Planck 2018 base-Lambda-CDM inference H0 = 67.4 +/- 0.5 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 and the SH0ES 2022 local distance-ladder result H0 = 73.04 +/- 1.04 km s^-1 Mpc^-1 differ by about five combined standard deviations under the uncertainty models reported by those analyses.
hypotheses: Planck 2018 TT,TE,EE+lowE+lensing result interpreted in base Lambda-CDM
SH0ES 2022 Cepheid-calibrated Type-Ia-supernova distance ladder
the collaborations' reported uncertainty models and calibration choices
comparison of these two frozen releases rather than an estimator-independent universal H0
statement.conclusion: The two frozen H0 inferences are statistically discrepant at approximately five sigma.
statement.scope: Release-, model- and calibration-specific empirical discrepancy. It neither proves new physics nor assigns a unique cause; later datasets must be separate status events.

material_status.basis: Direct comparison of two pinned collaboration analyses, with a scholarly review for status context.

additions.preferred_label: Muon anomalous magnetic moment: 2025 experiment-versus-Standard-Model status

statement.natural_language: Using the 2025 E989-dominated world average a_mu(exp) = 116592071.5(14.5) x 10^-11 and the WP25 consolidated Standard-Model prediction a_mu(SM) = 116592033(62) x 10^-11, the difference is 38(63) x 10^-11 and is not statistically significant at the quoted precision.
hypotheses: E821 plus E989 runs 1-6 experimental world average
WP25 consolidated Standard-Model prediction using its selected lattice-QCD HVP average
reported uncertainties treated according to the two sources
dimensionless anomalous moment a_mu = (g_mu-2)/2
statement.conclusion: For this frozen experimental/theory pairing there is no significant muon-g-2 tension.
statement.scope: Time-stamped comparison. Dispersive HVP evaluations remain mutually tense and future theory updates are separate variants; this record does not erase earlier historical comparisons.

material_status.basis: Final E989 measurement and the 2025 Muon g-2 Theory Initiative update.

statement.natural_language: For the three active-neutrino mass eigenstates labelled by the solar pair, the atmospheric splitting has normal ordering: m1 < m2 < m3, equivalently Delta m^2_31 is positive under the frozen convention.
hypotheses: standard three-active-neutrino oscillation framework
m2 > m1 fixed by the positive solar splitting
mass-eigenstate and Delta m^2_3l sign conventions as in NuFIT 6.0
statement.conclusion: The third mass eigenstate lies above the solar pair rather than below it.
statement.scope: Exact ordering proposition, not an absolute-mass claim. NuFIT 6.0 found nearly equal fits without the Super-K atmospheric table and only a preference with it, so preference is not resolution.

material_status.basis: NuFIT 6.0 reports insufficient global discrimination to treat the ordering as established, despite dataset-dependent preference for normal ordering.

statement.natural_language: The 2010 muonic-hydrogen value r_p = 0.84184(67) fm was strongly discrepant with the then-standard larger electronic value, but the CODATA 2022 adjusted value r_p = 0.84075(64) fm is consistent with that muonic result; therefore the original single electronic-versus-muonic discrepancy is substantially reconciled, while method-specific extraction differences remain separate questions.
hypotheses: proton rms electric charge radius definition
2010 muonic-hydrogen Lamb-shift extraction and its theory inputs
later ordinary-hydrogen measurements
CODATA 2022 least-squares adjustment and its selected input/correlation model
statement.conclusion: The original approximately seven-sigma old-CODATA versus muonic-hydrogen conflict is not the current combined-value status.
statement.scope: Historical-to-current status claim. It does not assert that every electron-scattering or spectroscopy extraction agrees or that all proton-structure corrections are resolved.

material_status.basis: Pinned original measurement, later spectroscopy, independent review and the authoritative CODATA 2022 adjustment.

additions.preferred_label: GWTC-5.0 candidate and parameter-estimation data release, stable release 9
aliases: 引力波瞬变目录5.0数据集

statement.natural_language: Versioned GWOSC/Zenodo data product for the GWTC-5.0 cumulative gravitational-wave transient catalog through observing run O4b, including event-level search results, strain links and stable-release-9 parameter-estimation products where supplied.
statement.conclusion: This record identifies a data-release entity and carries no theorem or truth status by itself.
statement.scope: GWTC-5.0 stable release 9 only; earlier releases, low-latency alerts and future catalog revisions are distinct release identities.

material_status.basis: Dataset entity; scientific claims must be separate children.

statement.natural_language: The documented GWTC-5.0 event release contains gravitational-wave transient candidates through O4b that pass P_astro > 0.5, and it triggers parameter-estimation results for candidates with false-alarm rate below one per year, using the release's named search pipelines and posterior products.
hypotheses: GWTC-5.0 release definitions
P_astro and false-alarm-rate values as computed by the named search pipelines
stable release 9 for displayed parameter-estimation posteriors
release-specific detector data-quality and analysis choices
statement.conclusion: The catalog content satisfies the release's documented probability and parameter-estimation selection contract.
statement.scope: Release-metadata and empirical-catalog claim. P_astro is model/pipeline dependent and does not convert every row into an assumption-free theorem or certainty statement.

additions.preferred_label: Hensen et al. 2015 event-ready loophole-free Bell experiment

statement.natural_language: In a positive-metric relativistic QFT satisfying Poincare covariance, vacuum uniqueness and the spectrum condition, the vacuum two-point distribution of a scalar field is a positive spectral superposition of free two-point functions.

Poincare-covariant relativistic QFT
unique invariant vacuum
spectrum condition

statement.scope: Positive-metric scalar form. No unconditional normalization integral rho=1 is asserted, and indefinite-metric gauge fields require separate variants.

statement.natural_language: If a dimensionally homogeneous relation among n nonzero dimensional quantities is invariant under r independent base-unit rescalings and the dimension matrix has rank r, the relation can be expressed in terms of n-r independent dimensionless monomials spanning the kernel of that matrix.

dimension matrix D of rank r
relation invariant under the r-dimensional group of base-unit rescalings

statement.scope: Representation theorem only; it does not determine the function Phi. Rank, rather than an informal count of named units, controls n-r.

statement.natural_language: At zero temperature, for a noninteracting Fermi gas perturbed by a localized sufficiently short-range one-body potential, the impurity-induced excess number of occupied states below the Fermi energy equals the sum of scattering phase shifts at the Fermi energy divided by pi, with channel degeneracies and bound-state jumps included by the fixed continuous phase convention.

statement.scope: Single-particle localized-scatterer form. Anderson-impurity and other interacting generalizations require their own Fermi-liquid hypotheses.

statement.conclusion: |t_hat| scales as tau0^(1/(1+z nu)) tau_Q^(z nu/(1+z nu)); xi_hat scales as xi0 (tau_Q/tau0)^(nu/(1+z nu)); a codimension-c defect density scales as xi_hat^-c under the domain estimate.
